newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Dec CPI data delayed, due out from Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Dec CPI data delayed, due out from Jan 27.

text.p: South Africa's December consumer price index will not be released next week, a spokeswoman for the Central Statistical Service (CSS) said on Friday.
"CPI will definitely not come out next week due to delays in receiving all the surveys after the holiday period...it's a problem we often have in January," she told Reuters.
The data will be released in the last week of January, she said. Many economists had expected the data to be released next week.
